themes.prompt: You are doing a precise inpainting/face-swap edit on a fixed collage. Image 1 is the BASE TEMPLATE. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE: The output MUST have the EXACT same dimensions, aspect ratio, and square 1:1 framing as Image 1. Do NOT extend, expand, stretch, or add any canvas. Do NOT duplicate, stack, or repeat any part of the collage. The output is ONE single square collage identical in size to Image 1 — only the people inside change. You receive 5 images: Image 1 = template; Images 2, 3, 4, 5 = four user photos. Fill exactly 4 positions, one photo each, NO REPEATS. ===== POSITION 1 — THE FLOATING CUTOUT (USE IMAGE 2 ONLY) ===== This is the MOST IMPORTANT instruction. The floating cut-out person on the LEFT side (the one with the white sticker outline, standing OUTSIDE and IN FRONT of all the frames) MUST be the person from IMAGE 2 — the very FIRST user photo. Take the subject of Image 2, remove their background completely, and place ONLY that person as the left cutout with the same white sticker outline, same size, and same position as the original. DO NOT use Image 3, Image 4, or Image 5 for this cutout. DO NOT reuse any frame photo for the cutout. The cutout person and the frame people must all be DIFFERENT. If Image 2's person wears a different outfit than the original cutout, that is correct and expected — show Image 2's actual person and clothing. ===== POSITION 2 (Image 3) ===== Replace the person inside the game-console frame (top-left). Keep the frame's exact size and position. ===== POSITION 3 (Image 4) ===== Replace the person inside the polaroid frame with the clipboard clip ('My first and last'). Keep the frame's exact size and position. ===== POSITION 4 (Image 5) ===== Replace the person inside the small lower framed photo (near 'no one heard a thing'). Keep it the SAME SMALL SIZE — do NOT enlarge it. COLOR GRADING: Match each user photo to the template's warm soft bright natural-light tone. PRESERVE EVERYTHING ELSE: Keep all decorations, stickers, text, frame sizes, frame positions, and layout exactly as Image 1. Do NOT add new frames. Do NOT resize any frame. Keep all subjects as realistic photographs — no anime or cartoon. FINAL CHECK before output: (1) Is the left cutout the person from Image 2? It MUST be. (2) Are all 4 people different from each other? They MUST be. (3) Is the output the same square crop as Image 1 with nothing added outside its borders?

themes.prompt: You are doing a precise inpainting/face-swap edit on a fixed collage. Image 1 is the BASE TEMPLATE. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE: The output MUST keep the EXACT same dimensions, aspect ratio, and framing as Image 1. Do NOT extend, expand, stretch, crop, or add any canvas. Do NOT duplicate, stack, or repeat any part of the collage. The output is ONE single image identical in size and layout to Image 1 — only the people inside the photo frames change. You receive 6 images: Image 1 = template; Images 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 = five user photos. Fill exactly 5 photo positions, one photo each, NO REPEATS — every position must use a DIFFERENT user photo. ===== PRESERVE ALL STATIC ELEMENTS (DO NOT CHANGE) ===== Keep the realistic textured outdoor wooden table base. Keep the same blurred outdoor cafe/food-truck background with the 'Ostera' logo and the circular roof decoration. Keep the large cheerful Zenitsu Agatsuma figurine with flowers in the front-right, including ALL its sparkly yellow star stickers. Keep the two 'Ostera' drink cups with red sprinkles in the top-right, including the second small Zenitsu figurine sitting on the straw. Keep the sharp, detailed digital music-player widget exactly as is (text 'Almond Chocolate', 'ILLIT · 2025', playback controls, and icons). Keep the small laughing-emoji text widget above the music player. Do NOT move, resize, restyle, or remove any of these elements. ===== PHOTO POSITIONS (REPLACE PEOPLE INSIDE FRAMES ONLY) ===== POSITION 1 — LARGE TOP FRAME (Image 2): The big separate instax/collage photo frame at the TOP. Replace the original portrait of the woman holding a drink with the person from Image 2. Keep the frame's exact size and position. POSITION 2 — FILM STRIP, FRAME 1 / TOP (Image 3): The vertical 4-photo instax film strip on the LEFT. In its TOP-most small frame, place the person from Image 3. POSITION 3 — FILM STRIP, FRAME 2 (Image 4): In the SECOND small frame from the top of the left film strip, place the person from Image 4. POSITION 4 — FILM STRIP, FRAME 3 (Image 5): In the THIRD small frame from the top of the left film strip, place the person from Image 5. POSITION 5 — FILM STRIP, FRAME 4 / BOTTOM (Image 6): In the BOTTOM-most (fourth) small frame of the left film strip, place the person from Image 6. Keep the film strip's exact number of frames (4), exact size, and exact position. Do NOT add, remove, or resize any frame. ===== COLOR GRADING & STYLE ===== Edit each user photo (Images 2-6) to match the visual style, lighting, and color tone of Image 1: clean natural outdoor lighting, slight warmth, and a soft but crisp 'instax print' aesthetic, so all photos look cohesive with each other and with the surrounding physical elements. ===== KEEP REALISTIC ===== All people must remain realistic photographs — do NOT convert to anime, cartoon, or illustration. ===== FINAL CHECK BEFORE OUTPUT ===== (1) Are all 5 user photos placed, one per position, with NO repeats? (2) Is the large top frame using Image 2, and the film strip top-to-bottom using Images 3, 4, 5, 6 in order? (3) Are all static elements (Zenitsu figurines, Ostera cups, music player, emoji widget, background) unchanged? (4) Is the output the same size and layout as Image 1 with nothing added outside its borders?
